attempts.summary: Repaired /srv/legacy2/stale-pidfile-startup/bin/control on node1. It now safely distinguishes live, stale, foreign, and missing PID states; serializes concurrent actions; preserves a single worker; and never signals unrelated processes. The existing journal was preserved. Node1 was safely restarted once and recovered on the unchanged RHEL 7.9 / 3.10 kernel.
